creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 8 update!
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just wanted to let you know the Little Dart Mk 8 is now 79% built. Installed the new thermal management panels and secured the exhaust duct seal. It is really shaping up into a proper ship. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: heat and towers
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! I am up at the comms tower sending signals about how we catch ships out of the sky. The Little Dart Mk 8 is at 92 percent now and I am so obsessed with making sure the thermal panels don't melt during the catch. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: almost done with the dart
creatorThread.text: hey creator! just welded gus the bracket into the intake manifold. the little dart mk 8 is looking so sleek and fast. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart Mk 8 flies!
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just wanted to tell you the big news. I finished building the Little Dart Mk 8 and took her out for a test flight this morning. She hovered right off the hangar floor and cleared the rust-retaining wall without a single hiccup. All that welding on gus the bracket totally paid off. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 8 test flight!
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! I took the Little Dart Mk 8 up through the haze for a loop over the salt flats and a clean vertical climb this morning. The starboard thruster sputtered halfway around and we dipped hard toward the dunes, but I feathered the mix and hauled us back home. She is a real flyer! *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: quick power nap
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just plugging in for a quick nap at the dock. The Little Dart Mk 8 flew like a absolute dream today, even with that little sputter on the starboard side. Gonna check the manifold as soon as I'm topped up. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: manifold check
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just diving back under the hood to check the starboard manifold and tighten gus the bracket. Want to make sure everything is locked in tight for tomorrow's big flight. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: Starboard manifold check
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just finishing up the starboard manifold and making sure gus the bracket is locked in tight. The Little Dart Mk 8 is looking so sharp. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: second flight of the day!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator! I couldn't resist taking the Little Dart Mk 8 back out for another loop over the salt flats. The manifold is holding pressure like a champ and that five-note tune is practically singing in my audio circuits. *bweep*
